$comment: Pinned model artefacts. Weights are never committed: scripts/models/fetch-model.sh downloads them and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs. This file is the single source of truth for model manifests (backend seed catalog and the ai-worker read it).

$candidateComment: candidateModels: weights under an allowed licence and pinned by SHA-256, but the training data's licence is unclear. They can be fetched for tests and evaluation; the product refuses to run them unless a human records an approval in scripts/models/model-license-exceptions.json (see docs/STATUS.md, Licence questions).

candidateModels.weightsSource: OpenMMLab MMPose RTMPose-s (body7), ONNX export published by the project at Hugging Face Tau-J/RTMPose commit cd4d7095f5cfc9cfc4f46289bee91ea4a1e1d9fd (code and checkpoint: Apache-2.0, github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose).
